item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera's teacher asks the class to classify resources as renewable or non-renewable. A renewable resource is replaced by natural processes within a reasonable time and does not get exhausted by use. A non-renewable resource takes millions of years to form and is finished once used up. Which resource should Meera classify as non-renewable?

options.A: Solar energy used by a rooftop water heater in Jaipur
options.B: Wind used by windmills in Tamil Nadu
options.C: Coal burnt in a power station near Nagpur
options.D: Firewood collected from a managed village forest
